reproduction_target: 3D genome (Hi-C) analysis of the wheat pathogen Zymoseptoria tritici IPO323: wet-lab Proximo Hi-C library prep + Illumina sequencing, followed by a computational pipeline (read trimming/QC, mapping, contact-matrix construction/ICE-correction, contact-probability decay, A/B compartmentalization, TAD calling, motif/feature enrichment, plus integration of public RNA-seq/ChIP-seq/WGBS datasets for expression and epigenetic profiling).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from Methods prose (biorxiv full-text HTML via reader proxy; JATS XML + biorxiv PDF were Cloudflare-blocked) + repo README (prose only, no workflow source read). HiCExplorer sub-functions (hicBuildMatrix/hicCorrectMatrix/hicPlotMatrix/hicConvertFormat/hicFindTADs) folded into one HiCExplorer step; cooltools/cooler folded into one step; XSTREME+Tomtom folded into one MEME-suite step. Wet-lab steps (culture, Proximo Hi-C library, NovaSeq sequencing) counted in W, not in S.

steps.label: Trimmomatic v0.39 — Hi-C read filtering/trimming (explicit ILLUMINACLIP/LEADING/TRAILING/SLIDINGWINDOW/MINLEN settings given)
HiCUP-0.9.2 — Hi-C dataset quality evaluation
bwa-mem2 — mapping Hi-C reads to Z. tritici IPO323 reference (no version pinned)

HiCExplorer suite — hicBuildMatrix (4-enzyme in-silico digest), hicCorrectMatrix (ICE), hicPlotMatrix, hicConvertFormat, hicFindTADs (multi-resolution 1/3/10/50 kb; TAD defaults) (suite named, no version pinned)
Circos-0.69 — interaction link plots of significant pairwise contacts
cooltools / cooler — .cool conversion, contact-probability decay (expected_cis), A/B compartments (expected_cis/expected_trans eigenvectors, saddleplot) (no version pinned)
R 4.4.1 glm (+ AER dispersiontest) — log-transformed Poisson regression of chromosome loss vs normalized interaction strength (R version pinned; model formula described)
ggplot2 — visualization of observed vs predicted chromosome loss (no version pinned)
topGO runGOEnrichment — GO term enrichment with FDR correction (no version pinned)
MEME suite — XSTREME (TAD-boundary motif discovery/enrichment) + Tomtom vs JASPAR (default parameters, no version pinned)
EnrichedHeatmap (R) — distribution of genes/TEs/RIP/histone marks/5mC across TADs and boundaries (no version pinned)
STAR — RNA-seq alignment (in planta / in vitro) to IPO323 with multimapping allowed (no version pinned)
TEtranscript — multimapper reassignment / gene + TE quantification (no version pinned)
DESeq2 — differential expression across biotrophic/necrotrophic/in-vitro conditions (no version pinned)
Bowtie2 — ChIP-seq read mapping to IPO323 (default settings, no version pinned)
Allo — multimapping read reassignment in repeat-rich regions (no version pinned)
Picard v2.26.2 — PCR duplicate removal + MAPQ<30 filtering for ChIP-seq (version pinned; filters described)
Bismark — bisulfite (WGBS) mapping, deduplication, bismark_methylation_extractor (CG/CHG/CHH, >=4 reads, >50% support) (no version pinned)
Custom Python linear/nested model — TAD co-expression (log2FC ~ TAD membership + GC + TE distance; AIC / likelihood-ratio) (no Python/library version pinned)
RIP composite index — custom 1 kb sliding-window RIP-like signature detection (method per Lorrain et al. 2021; no version/tool pin)

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 5/20 computational steps that pin exact tool versions (C1 Trimmomatic v0.39, C2 HiCUP-0.9.2, C5 Circos-0.69, C7 R 4.4.1 glm, C17 Picard v2.26.2). R★ not assignable at stage1. Stage2-eligible (capture_claim=release_snapshot: scripts archived at Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15395556 + Hi-C data at GEO), but even a stage2 pass cannot promote to R★ without validated env capture — no environment.yml / lockfile / container / pinned R+Python+package closure evidenced in the README. The other 15 steps (bwa-mem2, HiCExplorer, cooltools/cooler, STAR, TEtranscript, DESeq2, Bowtie2, Allo, Bismark, topGO, MEME/XSTREME, EnrichedHeatmap, ggplot2, custom Python model, RIP index) cap at NI on unpinned (floating) versions.
headline.coverage: 20 computational steps assessed from Methods prose (biorxiv full-text HTML) + GitHub README (prose only). Wet-lab Proximo Hi-C library prep + NovaSeq sequencing (W=3) not scored on the computational readiness axes. Public RNA-seq/ChIP-seq/WGBS datasets are cited with accessions.
